snippet.title: OmniMart Tycoon - Official Gameplay Trailer - Build the Supermarket of your Dreams
snippet.description:
Wishlist OmniMart Tycoon on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5015550/OmniMart_Tycoon/

BUILD YOUR SUPERMARKET. KEEP THE CUSTOMERS COMING.
Design your own supermarket from the ground up and manage everything that happens inside it.

Arrange aisles, stock shelves, set prices, hire employees, and keep customers happy as your small store grows into a retail empire.

A supermarket is easy to build. Making it profitable is another story.

DESIGN, BUILD & OPTIMIZE.
Create your own supermarket, one aisle at a time. Place shelves and storage, arrange departments, position checkouts, and design a layout that keeps customers moving.

Experiment with different store layouts, make the most of your available space, and turn an empty building into a shopping destination.

STOCK SMART. PRICE SMARTER.
Manage the inventory, order from suppliers, and keep your shelves stocked. Balance supply and demand while dealing with delivery delays and products that spoil over time.

Set your own prices, launch promotions, and find the sweet spot between attracting customers and maximizing profits. Overstock perishables and watch your money spoil. Run out of popular products and watch customers leave.

MANAGE CUSTOMERS & EMPLOYEES.
Every customer has somewhere to go and something to buy. Watch shoppers navigate your store, search for products, fill their baskets, and queue at checkouts.

Hire cashiers, stockers, cleaners, service desk clerks, and administrators to keep everything running. Organize shifts, manage wages, improve employee morale to make them work more efficiently.

Long queues, empty shelves, and unhappy employees can quickly turn a successful store into a struggling business.

EXPAND AND UNLOCK NEW POSSIBILITIES.
Start with the essentials and grow into something bigger. Develop new departments including fresh produce, bakery, frozen and canned goods.

Invest in research projects to unlock new equipment, technologies, and business capabilities. Improve your operations, build your reputation, and take your supermarket to the next level.

KEEP THE BUSINESS RUNNING.
Running a supermarket is full of surprises. Seasonal shopping rushes, changing customer demand, equipment breakdowns, theft, spills, and long checkout queues will put your management skills to the test.

Track revenue, profit margins, customer satisfaction, and employee morale. Identify problems, adapt your strategy, and keep your business growing.

Every decision matters. Every department counts. And there's always something that needs your attention.

BUILD THE SUPERMARKET OF YOUR DREAMS.
Welcome to OmniMart Tycoon.

#OmniMartTycoon #TycoonGame #ManagementGame #IndieGame #SimulationGame
